prompt: gives me 3 suggestions to thing to do in Paris
response:
1. Visit the Louvre Museum to see world-renowned artworks like the Mona Lisa.
2. Explore the charming streets of Montmartre and visit the Sacré-Cœur Basilica for a panoramic view of the city.
3. Enjoy a boat tour on the Seine River to see famous landmarks from a different perspective.
